comment: Day 3, second frozen holdout — the set the pack-mode repair is scored on. Set #1 (cases_day3.json) was spent scoring the cosine arm and must not be reused for a candidate; this set was authored after that verdict and before the hybrid arm was run, so the comparison stays honest. Same rules: evidence spans read out of the code, one corpus root per case, no case shared with set #1. No `dev` split: the candidate (PackMode::Hybrid) has no tuned parameter — RRF k is fixed in physis-core — so there is nothing to fit and every case is held out.
